title: The Powerpuff Girls New
description: Three colorful, sugarcoated kids trying to juggle school and save the world before bedtime.

episodes.title: S1-E26In the Garden of Good and Eddie
S1-E29The Secret Life of Blossom Powerpuff

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x1
episodes_data.description: Bubbles wins two tickets to a concert and has to pick between Blossom and Buttercup to go with her. Meanwhile, the Mayor's plane goes down over Monster Island and it's up to the girls to rescue him.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x2
episodes_data.description: Buttercup becomes enamored with a team of roller derby girls called the Derbytantes. When she starts spending all of her time with them, Princess Morbucks seeks to be her replacement in the Powerpuff Girls.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x3
episodes_data.description: Blossom and Buttercup suffer a candy hangover, and they must retrace their steps to find where they left Bubbles.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x4
episodes_data.description: A rainbow causes everyone to be unnaturally happy.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x5
episodes_data.description: Donny the Pony is transformed into a monster that threatens Townsville.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x6
episodes_data.description: When Buttercup's aggression inadvertently allows villain Man-Boy to escape, she starts a new-age lifestyle in an effort to be more calm. But when Man-Boy returns to enact his revenge, Buttercup must embrace the balance between punching and hugging in order to defeat him.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x7
episodes_data.description: The Mayor of Townsville overworks the Powerpuff Girls after his secretary Sara Bellum quits.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x8
episodes_data.description: Buttercup tries to teach Bubbles a lesson; it backfires.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x9
episodes_data.description: Bubbles breaks her arm and gets a powerful robotic cast just in time to face the Pack Rat.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x10
episodes_data.description: During a fight, both Buttercup and Bubbles are surprised to discover they've leveled up, leaving Blossom to wonder about her own powers.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x11
episodes_data.description: The Townsville Beauty, Talent, and All-Around Flair Pageant is cursed by a mysterious tiara.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x12
episodes_data.description: A potion intended to make them older backfires, and the Powerpuff Girls become senior citizens.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x13
episodes_data.description: The Professor has a new girlfriend; the girls plot and scheme to break up their budding relationship.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x14
episodes_data.description: Blossom accidentally unleashes evil spirits when she gets overzealous with the spring cleaning.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x15
episodes_data.description: Blossom tries to impress a famous scientist who visits the school.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x16
episodes_data.description: The girls end up as accomplices in their new friend's adventurous crimes.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x17
episodes_data.description: Chased by a dragon, Princess Bluebell accidentally crosses from her fairytale dimension to the Powerpuff Girls's world. She explains through song and dance that she's a damsel in distress. The Girls try to teach her to be independent.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x18
episodes_data.description: When someone steals all the water in Townsville, it's up to the Girls to race through the Townsville Wastelands to get it back.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x19
episodes_data.description: After the new trendy app was created in Townsville, the powerpuff girls soon uncover a dangerous glitch in the program.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x20
episodes_data.description: When Bubbles gets a bad school photo, it sends her into an existential tailspin of darkness.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x21
episodes_data.description: When Blossom and Bubbles get sick, Buttercup volunteers to take care of them for the day.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x22
episodes_data.description: Donny the Unicorn and Big Joey participate in the Student/Unicom Exchange Program. Bubbles has many planned activities but Donny is doing them with Chelsea. At first Bubbles is upset but decides to meet Her since Donny likes Chelsea so much. Buttercup thinks Chelsea is a Bubbles 2.0. Donny and Bubbles argue later that night and Donny decides to stay at Chelseas place. Trying to comfort Bubbles; Blossom and Buttercup realize Donny is likely in trouble and set out to try and save him

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x23
episodes_data.description: When Morbucks enters the Student Body President race, Blossom sinks to her level to secure the win.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x24
episodes_data.description: After finding a baby monster in the park, Bubbles insists on adopting it without considering the consequences!

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x25
episodes_data.description: When the Fashionistas launch a new line of brainwashing clothing, it's up to the Powerpuff Girls to stop the fashion trend before it's too late.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x26
episodes_data.description: When the girls try a quick-fix on their neglected veggie garden, they are left with a giant, mooching tomato worm they must care for.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x27
episodes_data.description: Realizing her and the Professor don't have much in common, Bubbles schedules a road trip with just the two of them.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x28
episodes_data.description: When the Professor's latest invention wreaks havoc in the house, it's up to the Powerpuff Girls to stop it before it escapes.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x29
episodes_data.description: When Blossom can't join her favorite school club, she imagines what her life would be like if she joined other clubs.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x30
episodes_data.description: When a series of negative articles about the Powerpuff Girls are posted on the Internet, the girls track them back to Silico.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x31
episodes_data.description: When the Girls get a Paper Fortune Teller that can predict the future if they tell it a secret, they begin to rely on it to predict everything.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x32
episodes_data.description: Its a rainy day and the girls are stuck inside and bored. Trouble quickly follows when the girls play with the Time Dasher in the Professors lab.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x33
episodes_data.description: To escape a monster, the girls have to tell him a scary story.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x34
episodes_data.description: Buttercup gets more than she bargained for when she makes a deal with a cool '80s metalhead to get a sweet new guitar.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x35
episodes_data.description: After the Professor's latest experiment goes awry, the girls become overprotective.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x36
episodes_data.description: When Morbucks loses her money, Blossom tries to reform her.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x37
episodes_data.description: After a snow day saves Blossom from having to face a boy who's asked her out, she decides to use her ice breath to keep it going even if that means plunging Townsville into eternal winter complete with monstrous yetis!

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x38
episodes_data.description: When the girls disobey the Professor and swing all the way over the swingset, they must deal with unexpected consequences.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New 1x39
episodes_data.description: Bubbles needs help with a model biome for school, but Blossom has other priorities.

episodes_data.title: The Powerpuff Girls New Season 2 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: When Donny the Unicorn is hunted by a seemingly unstoppable foe, the Powerpuff Girls have to find a way to save him before it's too late.
